{{Top|leg}}
'''Repulsor buoys''' were used to mark the course of a [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racing]] track, such as the [[binary nebula]]. They could be configured to shoot [[ion flare]]s which were designed to disrupt the control and flight systems of participating [[Swoop/Legends|swoops]] for an extra degree of challenge.
